one_minute_value_explanation: v11.7 lets operators see the provider-read decision state in Mission Control: accepted, blocked, reopened, deferred, or needs review, with the feedback route and next action attached.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.6 captured external operator feedback; v11.7 turns that feedback into a visible provider-read decision replay.
product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot tell whether provider-read feedback accepted, blocked, or reopened work from Mission Control, reopen this capability as a product issue.
not_proven: Capability delta does not prove broad adoption, market value, or provider truth.
